name: Claude SEO
tagline: A free SEO audit that runs inside Claude Code - checks your site for search engines and AI search, then tells you what to fix first.
sentence: Runs a full website audit - technical health, content quality, structured data, and AI search readiness - and hands you a prioritized fix list, all from inside Claude Code.

board.say: You don't know if search engines and AI assistants (like ChatGPT or Perplexity) can find and understand your website.
A website URL. It auto-detects your business type (online store, local business, software company, publisher, or agency).
Up to 17 specialist agents check your site in parallel, scan up to 500 pages, and sort findings by priority.
steps: Detects your business type and picks the right checks
Up to 17 agents check technical health, content, structured data, and AI search readiness in parallel
Scans up to 500 pages with a headless browser (a browser that reads pages without showing them)
Scores findings and sorts them by priority - what to fix first, second, third, and which fixes unlock others

board.say: A prioritized action plan saved as a report, with each fix explained and a way to verify it.

outputs.eg: A structured-data report for rankenstein.pro returned a B+ grade with two critical issues including a founder mismatch
`/seo geo` checks whether AI search engines can find and cite your pages

before: Pay $100-300/month for SEO tools, or hire an agency to audit your site
No way to know if AI assistants like ChatGPT or Perplexity can cite your content
after: A free audit inside the tool you already use, with a fix list sorted by impact
`/seo geo` checks whether AI search engines can find and cite your pages
One command to recheck after fixes - no switching to another tool
uses_note: The author reports 10.8K Search Console clicks and 324K impressions over 12 weeks on their own showcase site, plus a 99 mobile PageSpeed score. These are self-reported, not independently verified. No independent user case studies found.

coverage.title: Claude SEO Review: What to Verify Before Using the Claude Code Skill
Review focused on AI search and GEO features

steps: In Claude Code, run `/plugin marketplace add AgriciDaniel/claude-seo` then `/plugin install claude-seo@agricidaniel-claude-seo`
Run `/seo setup` to install the isolated Python runtime and headless browser
Run `/seo audit` on a page you own and read the prioritized report
try.paste:
/skillspector https://github.com/AgriciDaniel/claude-seo
Then: Install via the plugin marketplace with `/plugin marketplace add AgriciDaniel/claude-seo`, run `/seo setup`, and audit a small site with `/seo audit <url>`. 10 minutes.

footprint.disk: Installs an isolated Python runtime and headless Chromium (exact size: no data found)
footprint.memory: Runs up to 5 Opus agents and 14 Sonnet agents in parallel; token cost depends on site size
footprint.runs_on: macOS, Windows, Linux (inside Claude Code 1.0.33+, Python 3.11-3.14)

best_for: Anyone with a website who wants a free, thorough SEO audit without paying for a tool
People who want to know if AI search engines can find and cite their content
Small business owners and creators who use Claude Code and want SEO built into their workflow
skip_if: Your site is larger than 500 pages - the crawl cap won't cover it
You need real-world performance data - without Google API keys, it gives lab estimates only
You already pay for Ahrefs, Semrush, or Screaming Frog and are happy with them

alternatives.name: Ahrefs Webmaster Tools
alternatives.line: Free tier of the industry standard - real backlink and ranking data, but no AI search readiness check

alternatives.name: Screaming Frog
alternatives.line: A desktop crawler that handles large sites - free up to 500 pages, no AI integration

watch: **Token cost.** A full audit runs up to 17 agents (5 on Opus, the most capable and expensive model), so it uses significant plan capacity on large sites.
**500-page crawl cap.** Not suited for sites with thousands of pages.
**Self-promotional footer** appended to most reports. Remove it before sending to clients.
**Without Google API keys, performance data is lab-only estimates** (not your real visitors' experience from Google Search Console).
